q: Which substance has the highest melting point?
Which substances are ionic? Use the data to explain.
Sodium chloride, magnesium oxide, calcium chloride: very high melting points.
Explain why ionic compounds have high melting points.
Strong electrostatic forces between oppositely charged ions in a giant lattice need lots of energy to break.
Suggest why magnesium oxide melts at a much higher temperature than sodium chloride.
Mg²⁺ and O²⁻ have double the charges of Na⁺ and Cl⁻, so the attraction between them is much stronger.
